sentences.text: Janiosteus was a member of the class Placodermi, an extinct group of armored fish.
This species belongs to the family Panxiosteidae.
The type species is Janiosteus timanicus.
Fossils have been found in Timan, Russia.
The animal lived during the Middle Devonian, specifically the Late Givetian stage.
A 2010 study suggested that the family Panxiosteidae was the sister taxon to Dunkleosteidae.
However, a 2016 study using a larger dataset placed Panxiosteidae outside Dunkleosteoidea, instead within Coccosteomorphi.
